thread:
alex: Heads up — after we upgraded the nvidia-device-plugin DaemonSet to ghcr.io/nvidia/device-plugin:v0.13.0 in eu-west-1 earlier this morning, ~40% of GPU nodes flipped their driver/annotation and started failing registration. Pods requesting specific driver/versions are Pending and some jobs are erroring out. Logs show: ```E0321 09:12:04.123 deviceplugin.go:412] Register failed: driver version mismatch: node reports 535.21, cluster expects 535.54``` 
jamie: Which DS image exactly and which AZs are hit? rollout status? 
alex: image is ghcr.io/nvidia/device-plugin:v0.13.0, rollout started ~09:05 UTC by deploy-bot, affected eu-west-1a and eu-west-1b primarily. deploy-bot showed initial 25% then spike in registration errors. 
ravi: This rings a bell — v0.13 introduced an annotation/label reconciliation change that can flip node driver labels if kernel module probe order differs. Suggest rollback to v0.12.4 and pin the image until we root cause. Quick patch: ```kubectl -n gpu-system set image daemonset/nvidia-device-plugin nvidia-device-plugin=ghcr.io/nvidia/device-plugin:v0.12.4``` 
emily: We're also seeing training jobs hit NCCL errors when they land on mixed-driver nodes: `NCCL WARN Call to cuDeviceGet failed` followed by job restarts. Dedicated GPU pool is underutilized while CPU fallback execs run — cost spike for the day. 
deploy-bot: daemonset/nvidia-device-plugin rollout 62% complete (eu-west-1a) — paused by operator due to failing readiness checks. 
alex: Mitigation plan: cordon affected nodes, drain non-critical GPU pods, patch DS to v0.12.4, and do a controlled AZ-by-AZ rollback. Need infra-sre to run remediation script and confirm node driver annotations after rollout. 
infra-sre-bot: Applied patch to eu-west-1a as a hotfix: `kubectl patch ds nvidia-device-plugin -n gpu-system --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/image","value":"ghcr.io/nvidia/device-plugin:v0.12.4"}]'` — rolling. Also cordoned 6 nodes in eu-west-1a and drained batch jobs. Creating a temporary admission check to block device-plugin changes without a canary. :lock: 
jamie: Good. We should also add a scheduler tolerance: relax exact-driver annotation predicate for 2 weeks while we validate, to avoid scheduling churn during rollouts. 
ravi: Agreed. Long term: add an e2e upgrade job that runs device-plugin + driver matrix on a staging fleet and a preflight that checks kernel-module probe ordering. I'll open a ticket with test matrix. 
emily: Can ops please calculate the cost delta (Dedicated underutilization + CPU fallback) for finance? Tagging @finance for visibility. We may need a brief credit for affected customers. 
alex: I'll draft a runbook entry and timeline. Will update when eu-west-1 is green. Thanks for the quick responses. 
infra-sre-bot: Post-action: eu-west-1a now at 100% with v0.12.4, node annotations reconciled, no new registration rejects in the last 12m. Rollout to eu-west-1b scheduled in 10m with canary 2 nodes first. Creating postmortem template and adding rollback gating to release pipeline.
